title: Time Loops
subtitle: the same day, again — films and single episodes
blurb: 15 films, 11 single episodes and one whole series where the day repeats. Assembled by the group; watch in any order.
notes: Nothing here leads to anything else — pick whatever tonight feels like. Nothing is weighted either: a 32-minute short and a two-hour film count one each, because this is a grab bag, not a schedule.
Each row names its show, season and episode; the loop episodes were built to work cold, which is most of why people love them.
7 entries were added beyond the group's thread and say so on the row — veto freely.
Assembled by the group in Discord. Every entry was verified against Wikipedia before it got a row — including which Tales of the Walking Dead episode the loop one actually is.
